Looping in a quick internal plan: 
- Per finance policy, we mark a deal as 'Commit' in the forecast only when an approved PO or signed contract with explicit payment terms is received. Verbal commit + SOW doesn't trigger recognition.
- If ACME can issue a PO by 05/14 we can send the initial invoice and aim to recognize in May. If PO lands 05/15 or later, revenue recognition would likely fall into next quarter — need to flag to CRO.
- Short-term option: ask ACME if they will accept a pro-forma invoice for immediate issuance while PO completes routing; this sometimes clears the recognition path if legal/finance on both sides accept.

I'll reach out to CS for any deliverable gating. Sean, can you confirm whether ACME would accept split invoicing (50% upfront, 50% on delivery) if that helps accelerate sign-off?

Thanks for the thread and the attachments — good detail. Summary and what finance needs to confirm recognition: 

1) PO timing requirement: To book and recognize revenue in May (Q2), we require an approved PO with an effective date on or before 2026-05-14 and a matching invoice dated the same period. If the PO is dated 2026-05-15 or later, revenue recognition will be deferred to next quarter per ASC guidance and our audit policy.

2) Minimum PO fields required: company legal name, Redwood vendor number (we'll provide), billing address, tax ID/EIN, PO number, currency and payment terms (Net 30 / Net 45), and approved total amount. Missing fields cause routing delays.

3) Pro-forma/invoices: We can accept a pro-forma invoice to start internal processing, but for external recognition we need either the approved PO or a signed contract with explicit payment terms. Pro-forma alone will not be sufficient for revenue recognition in the period.

4) Split invoicing: Acceptable only if the PO references split billing and total committed amount; finance will treat each invoice against the PO and recognize revenue when contractual criteria are met. This can help accelerate partial recognition but requires procurement sign-off.

Next steps I recommend we share a one-page checklist with ACME (I've attached our Billing Checklist) and provide Redwood vendor details and W9. If ACME can confirm a PO dated <= 2026-05-14, we will prioritize invoice issuance same day.

Neha Kapoor
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
